headline: I like being the person who figures it out.
intro: I work in marketing, but I've never been great at staying in one lane. I like taking an idea and seeing it through, whether that means writing something, figuring out a campaign, getting into the design, or building a little tool to make things easier.

testimonials.name: Karthik Kamalakannan
testimonials.quote: I have rarely seen anyone who would go out of their way to get things done.
testimonials.highlight: go out of their way to get things done

testimonials.name: Swathy Ravisankar
testimonials.quote: From day one, her creativity stood out. She had a knack for coming up with innovative ideas for our content strategies and marketing campaigns.
